# IndiaMART

> IndiaMART is a comprehensive B2B marketplace connecting Indian manufacturers, suppliers, and exporters with global buyers across construction materials, building supplies, and industrial equipment.

IndiaMART serves as a digital directory and trading platform for India's manufacturing and export sector, featuring leading brands in construction materials (TMT bars, PVC pipes, paints), heavy equipment manufacturers (TATA, Komatsu, Hyundai), and industrial suppliers. The platform facilitates cross-border commerce by connecting verified Indian suppliers with international buyers.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Indian Manufacturers
- Suppliers Directory
- Exporters
- Building Materials
- Construction Equipment
- TMT Bars
- PVC Pipes
- Paint Manufacturers
- Industrial Equipment
- Buyers-Sellers Network
- India Trade
- Manufacturing Directory
- Global Commerce

## Core Platform

- [IndiaMART - Indian Manufacturers Suppliers Exporters Directory](https://m.indiamart.com/): Main B2B marketplace connecting Indian manufacturers, suppliers, and exporters globally with comprehensive directory and trading features.
